verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents event subscriptions: KV, Workers AI, Workers builds and similar products publish structured events, with a schema catalog, to a Queue. You consume them with a Worker or an HTTP pull consumer, not via push webhooks to an arbitrary URL. The Agents SDK also says it can connect incoming webhooks to a durable agent runtime, and Workflows can pause for external events, so a webhook-like flow is possible but takes extra building. Missing for 10: native outbound webhook delivery of account events to a user-supplied endpoint, webhook signing/retry documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
